description: Configure spell checking for a Python project being prepared for open-source release. Install the Code Spell Checker extension (streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker), configure a workspace-level custom dictionary in .vscode/settings.json with the following technical terms: AuthN, AuthZ, CRMSync, SalesforceAPI, MetricsAgg, TimeSeries, RefreshToken, JWTValidator. The workspace is at /home/ga/workspace/auth-sync-lib/ and contains README.md and auth_provider.py with intentional typos. Fix at least 8 typos in README.md (examples: syncronizing->synchronizing, automaticaly->automatically, managment->management, suports->supports, configurate->configure, libary->library, initalize->initialize, miliseconds->milliseconds, Maximun->Maximum, Licnese->License) and at least 5 typos in auth_provider.py docstrings (examples: authentification->authentication, syncronize->synchronize, suports->supports, defualt->default, proccess->process). Add the custom dictionary terms to cSpell.words setting in workspace settings.json.
